effects.effect: Until the end of the encounter, the size of your [Null Field](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-1/null-field) ability increases by 1. While the area of that ability is enlarged this way, you ignore [difficult terrain](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/difficult-terrain) and reduce the [potency](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/potency) of enemy effects targeting you by 1 for you. You can also use a free [triggered action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/triggered-action) at the start of each of your turns to end one effect on you that is ended by a [saving throw](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.general/saving-throw) or that ends at the end of your [turn](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn). Each ally in the area also gains these benefits.

| **Psionic** | **[Maneuver](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn)** |
|-------------|-------------:|
| **📏 Self** |  **🎯 Self** |

**Effect:** Until the end of the encounter, the size of your [Null Field](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-1/null-field) ability increases by 1. While the area of that ability is enlarged this way, you ignore [difficult terrain](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/difficult-terrain) and reduce the [potency](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/potency) of enemy effects targeting you by 1 for you. You can also use a free [triggered action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/triggered-action) at the start of each of your turns to end one effect on you that is ended by a [saving throw](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.general/saving-throw) or that ends at the end of your [turn](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn). Each ally in the area also gains these benefits.
